title: The merge tool judges each check by the newest run on the head
why: The shared merge tool refused q_max PR #1003 on a duplicate run that concurrency cancelled when the PR went ready (run 41368432206), although the newer run on the same head passed (41368432483). It will recur on every child-repo integration PR opened as a draft and then marked ready.
note: Fix: bin/merge reads each check by its newest run on the PR head and ignores runs a later run on the same head superseded. Red first: a fixture with a cancelled older run and a green newer run on one head merges; a head whose newest run is cancelled or red is refused. Workaround used Nov 1: re-ran the cancelled run. Basis: named incident (q_max #1003, Nov 1 19:18 CST, coordinator). Port: yes, the merge tool is shared. Ready.
